subject: Confession: I built this at 2AM
preview_text: I don't usually write emails like this, but I need to tell you something real about Loudify.
body_paragraphs: I don't usually write emails like this. But it's 2AM, I just pushed an update, and I need to tell you something I've never put in writing before.

When I started Loudify, it wasn't about making another audio app. It was because I was sitting on a train, headphones on, volume maxed, and I still couldn't hear the dialogue in my audiobook over the HVAC. That moment, I realized the slider isn't a wall—it's a promise that someone broke. So I built something that actually works. Not a generic booster that distorts when things get loud, but a tool that knows your headphones, tunes them the moment they connect, and gives you +200% volume without the harshness.

That's what AutoEQ does. It remembers your headphones—every time. And the Sound DNA recap? That's not a gimmick. It's your actual listening data, delivered weekly, so you can see how you hear. I built this for you, for commuters, gamers, music lovers—anyone who's tired of audio that doesn't deliver.

Open Loudify now. Connect your headphones. Tap the AutoEQ preset for your model. Hear the difference. That's all I ask. P.S. The top streak on the global leaderboard right now is 47 days. You're welcome to take it.
